cues.text: Every season, farming cooperatives in Bangladesh
pay for seed, fertilizer and labour
weeks before the harvest brings money in.
That gap is predictable,
but almost nobody measures it.
So cooperatives borrow by headline interest rate,
not by when the money arrives
or when it must be repaid.
And an AI that can move money or invent numbers
would make things worse, not better.
FarmLink AI is a finance copilot for cooperatives.
It turns their records into a forecast,
compares financing honestly,
and prepares an application.
But only a human can submit it.
Here is our demo cooperative.
FarmLink projects cash day by day
and finds the exact moment it runs out:
in seven days, on the 27th of October.
The gap is 425,000 taka.
Then it checks eight financing options
against that exact gap.
Does the money arrive in time?
Can it be repaid from this season's cash?
Two options fit.
Every other one gets a clear reason why not.
But cheapest is not always safest.
FarmLink replays the season with a late harvest,
lower sales and higher costs.
Borrowing only the gap fails every test.
Add a small buffer,
and the best option survives
a late harvest and a sales drop.
With live AI, you can simply ask.
The Gemini-powered agent plans the steps
and calls our tools,
and every number comes from tested code,
never from the AI's guess.
When the application is ready, it stops.
Only a person can confirm the exact terms.
If anything changes after review,
the confirmation is cancelled.
No real money moves.
Every step is logged as evidence.
FarmLink AI.
The AI prepares, the cooperative decides.
Try it today at tanbin-cs.github.io/Farmlink-AI
